name: MCRD San Diego
description: For many Marines, San Diego was where military life began. The base opened in 1921, took over West Coast recruit training from Mare Island in 1923, and received the name Marine Corps Recruit Depot San Diego in 1948. By 1965, it was an established place for turning civilians into Marines before they continued to further training and unit assignments.
